method: Rigid authored 3D geometry with painted material textures; depth-buffered orthographic bake, not a warp of an existing building sprite.
geometry: Shared 2:1 camera, equal upright posts, parallel roof ridge/eaves and centered front gable.
style_review: Compared at 1500x1050 on actual day/night village terrain and enlarged in the shared projection inspector. Warm clay and timber material palette derived from the existing house; foliage reuses the village fern atlas.
scope: Shed only; does not certify the other building artwork.
